text: Security is an essential part of web development. Every website should use HTTPS to protect data as it travels between the user and the server. Authentication helps confirm that users are who they claim to be, usually through passwords or two-factor methods. Input validation is also important because it checks the data users submit and blocks harmful content. Common vulnerabilities, such as SQL injection and cross-site scripting, often appear when developers ignore these basic protections. By applying HTTPS, strong authentication, and careful input validation, developers can reduce risks and build safer, more trustworthy websites for everyone.
